reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Shaping inclusive technology governance frameworks
themes.definition: Calls to proactively shape inclusive, safe, transparent and accountable governance frameworks for AI and technology, with developing countries participating in rule-making.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for governance principles/frameworks for AI and technology and inclusive rule-making.
themes.exclusion: Exclude cybercrime convention references (AI_CYBER_SECURITY) unless tied to AI governance.
themes.boundary_cases: Governance framed around sovereignty is also coded AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION.

examples.quote: we must proactively shape technology governance so that progress serves humanity in our common development
We need to develop inclusive, safe, transparent, and accountable principles and governance frameworks

themes.label: Digital sovereignty and avoiding dependency
themes.definition: Insistence that technology not create new dependencies and that governance respect national and digital sovereignty and the right to development.
themes.inclusion: Include references to digital sovereignty, avoiding technological dependency, or right to development in technology governance.
themes.exclusion: Exclude access-gap statements without sovereignty/dependency framing.
themes.boundary_cases: 'Narrow divides' within the same sentence is also coded AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: rather than creating new forms of dependency or new sources of conflict
respecting national sovereignty, digital sovereignty, and the right to development

themes.label: Infrastructure support and equitable access
themes.definition: Developing countries receiving support for infrastructure and digital capacity and equitable access to technological benefits.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for infrastructure support, digital capacity-building and equitable access for developing countries.
themes.boundary_cases: Capacity-building in combating cybercrime counts under AI_CYBER_SECURITY.

examples.quote: receive support for infrastructure and digital capacity, and enjoy equitable access to the benefits of scientific and technological progress

themes.label: Unprecedented opportunities and new challenges
themes.definition: Framing AI and digital transformation as opening unprecedented opportunities while presenting new challenges.
themes.inclusion: Include explicit opportunity/challenge pairings about AI.
themes.boundary_cases: When followed by governance proposals, code both.

examples.quote: artificial intelligence are opening up unprecedented opportunities. but they're also presenting new challenges

themes.label: Cybercrime cooperation for safe technology
themes.definition: International cooperation and capacity to prevent cybercrime so people can benefit safely from technological progress.
themes.inclusion: Include references to cybercrime conventions and cooperation against cybercrime in a technology context.
themes.boundary_cases: Hosting treaty signings is coded here even if AI is not named in that sentence, when within the AI/technology discussion.

examples.quote: build capacity in preventing and combating cyber crime so that people may live safely and benefit from technological progress

value.rationale: Both Vietnam passages come from one development-focused technology segment: AI as opportunity and challenge, requiring inclusive governance that respects digital sovereignty, provides capacity support, and addresses cybercrime.
